title: Oven Roasted Chinese Boudin Noir Dumplings
description: Rich, flaky, date-night Chinese dish featuring boudin-noir, cure, egg-free-friendly, served in scallop shells
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together boudin noir, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the boudin noir mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Moisten the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Place the dumplings in scallop shells, leaving a small space between each dumpling.
Brush the tops of the dumplings with a small amount of sesame oil.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the wrappers are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
